name: integration-idle-healthy
title: Healthy grid, boost idle
purpose: A 230 V / 50 Hz grid is present from t = 0 and the boost stays in IDLE. Checks that the C-Block runs at the control period, that the grid observer qualifies after its 1 s dwell and the PLL aligns (one-period averages; inverter stage OFF), and that no leg, bridge or relay is driven. The bus is not energised; no DC/DC power flows.
